### Leakage audit

| feature group / column                                               | used     | time of information   | n features   | examples                                                                      | why                                                                                                                                                                   |
|:---------------------------------------------------------------------|:---------|:----------------------|:-------------|:------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| lag_aqi                                                              | YES      | days D-29..D          | 16           | aqi_l0, aqi_l1, aqi_l2, aqi_l3, aqi_l4 ...                                    | Past AQI only (lags 0-6, rolling windows ending at D). AQI(D) is complete at 24:00 of D. Gaps filled causally (same-day neighbours, ffill, train-period climatology). |
| lag_poll                                                             | YES      | days D-6..D           | 24           | PM25_mean_l0, PM10_mean_l0, NO2_mean_l0, SO2_mean_l0, CO_8h_l0 ...            | Pollutant daily means/8-h maxima and intraday shape of day D. These are inputs to AQI, but of day D, not D+1, so they are legitimate lags.                            |
| missing                                                              | YES      | day D                 | 6            | PM25_nh_l0, PM10_nh_l0, aqi_nsub_l0, miss_aqi_l0, miss_aqi_7d ...             | Valid-hour counts and missing flags of day D; sensor gaps are informative (more gaps on polluted days).                                                               |
| spatial                                                              | YES      | day D                 | 5            | city_aqi_l0, city_pm25_l0, state_aqi_l0, city_nst_l0, city_aqi_rm3            | Mean AQI/PM2.5 of OTHER stations in the same city/state on day D. Same-time readings of OTHER stations at D+1 are NOT used.                                           |
| met_site                                                             | YES      | day D                 | 8            | site_WS_l0, site_RH_l0, site_AT_l0, site_SR_l0, site_BP_l0 ...                | OBSERVED weather from the station's own CPCB sensors (WS, RH, AT, SR, BP, RF, WD) for day D. Reported live, so available at issue time.                               |
| Weather of the target day D+1 (observed)                             | EXCLUDED | day D+1               | -            | nan                                                                           | Observed future weather = leakage for a true forecast. We use observed weather up to D only (no weather forecast input).                                              |
| ERA5 reanalysis (any day)                                            | NOT USED | -                     | -            | nan                                                                           | Published ~5 days after real time (ERA5T), so even day-D values would not exist at 24:00 of D.                                                                        |
| fire                                                                 | YES      | days D-6..D           | 6            | fire_100km_l0, fire_300km_l0, frp_300km_l0, fire_300km_rm3, fire_PB_HR_l0 ... | NASA FIRMS MODIS detections up to day D (near real-time product exists).                                                                                              |
| calendar                                                             | YES      | day D+1               | 8            | doy_sin, doy_cos, month, dow, weekend ...                                     | Day of year/week, Diwali distance, lockdown flag of D+1: known in advance.                                                                                            |
| static                                                               | YES      | -                     | 5            | lat, lon, elevation, region_code, clim_aqi_month                              | Coordinates, elevation, region; station-month AQI climatology computed from the TRAINING period only.                                                                 |
| AQI(D+1), AQI_cat, AQI_driver, sub-indices SI_* of D+1               | EXCLUDED | day D+1               | -            | nan                                                                           | Deterministic function of the target day's pollutant concentrations: hands the model the answer.                                                                      |
| Pollutant concentrations of D+1 (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, CO, O3, NH3) | EXCLUDED | day D+1               | -            | nan                                                                           | Inputs of the target AQI: not available when the forecast is issued.                                                                                                  |
| y_pm25 (PM2.5 of D+1)                                                | EXCLUDED | day D+1               | -            | nan                                                                           | Kept in the table for diagnostics only, never a feature.                                                                                                              |
| Centred rolling windows / two-sided interpolation                    | NOT USED | -                     | -            | nan                                                                           | Would mix D+1.. values into day-D features. All windows are trailing; linear interpolation was evaluated only in the offline reconstruction test.                     |
| Sensor-fault QA rules                                                | SAFE     | same calendar day     | -            | nan                                                                           | Stuck-sensor and spike checks use only data of the same day, so cleaning of day D never looks at D+1.                                                                 |
| Imputer / scaler / PCA statistics                                    | SAFE     | training period       | -            | nan                                                                           | Medians, climatology, StandardScaler and PCA are fitted on training rows only, then applied to val/test.                                                              |
